entries.title: The Colonists

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Colonists first released on Steam in 2018, then later came to PlayStation, Xbox, and Switch through Auroch Digital's Console Edition route. No sourced console-exclusive content was found in this pass. Windows PC remains the best archive route because it has the original release path, best capture/settings control, and the cleanest keyboard/mouse interface for this Anno/Settlers-style city-builder.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC Steam release for the main archive route. Use console versions only for couch/portable comparison captures.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console Edition is a port route, not a remaster or separate game entry.
